description: Interface contract for combining Zettlr --data-dir profile isolation with a Pandoc batch-export pipeline.
source: art_01M6WJTB83S88GF5B1H8H1V5EP r1 (Zettlr README at commit f2f20646)

interfaces.name: Profile root
interfaces.contract: Absolute path to a writable directory; no tilde; no spaces unless quoted by the shell. Zettlr writes config.json and app.db here, NOT in the default platform location.
interfaces.failure_if_broken: Zettlr silently falls back to the default data dir; project configs bleed across profiles.

interfaces.name: Markdown source tree
interfaces.producer: Zettlr (writes .md files into the workspace folder opened inside the profile)
interfaces.contract: UTF-8 Markdown files; YAML front-matter block at top of file for Pandoc metadata (title, author, date). File tree is stable only when Zettlr is NOT running (file locks on Windows).
interfaces.failure_if_broken: Pandoc reads a partially saved file or a file Zettlr has locked; output is corrupt or the export script errors.

interfaces.name: LaTeX intermediate (optional)
interfaces.producer: Pandoc (--to latex) or Zettlr's own export if LaTeX is installed
interfaces.contract: LaTeX engine on PATH; a .tex file with no undefined commands from the chosen Pandoc template. Without LaTeX, only HTML/DOCX outputs work from both tools.
interfaces.failure_if_broken: PDF export is unavailable; Zettlr README and Pandoc both document this dependency explicitly.

shared_assumptions: Zettlr is closed before the batch export runs (avoids file-lock races on Windows, partial-write races everywhere).
DATA_DIR is an absolute path; the script does not expand tildes.
Pandoc is on PATH at export time.
Source .md files use consistent YAML front-matter; Pandoc silently drops metadata fields it does not recognise.
